title: Fix the basket flags
prompt: This checkout report should list the skus bought two or more at a time and flag baskets with a premium item, but both columns come out wrong. Fix `solve(checkout_events)`.
rules: `repeat_skus` lists the skus of items with a `qty` of 2 or more, in basket order.
`has_premium` is true when at least one item has a unit `price` of 150.00 or more. An empty basket gives an empty `repeat_skus` and false.
Keep one row per checkout step, duplicates included.
hints: Run the starter and compare a basket with an item bought twice, such as CO-0001, against the expected result.
Read each comparison aloud: does `> 2` include 2?
"At least one item" and "every item" are different higher-order functions.
explanation: Two bugs. The filter used `x["qty"] > 2`, which leaves out items bought exactly twice; "2 or more" is `>= 2`. And `has_premium` used `F.forall`, which asks whether every item is premium; one premium item is enough, which is `F.exists("items", lambda x: x["price"] >= 150)`. The `forall` version also says true for an empty basket, since no item fails, while `exists` correctly says false. The fixed report keeps the filter-then-transform chain for `repeat_skus`.
